title: Error Tracking
definition: Automatically capturing unhandled promise rejections and JS runtime errors (e.g., `TypeError: undefined is not a function`), grabbing the stack trace, and alerting the engineering team.
simpleExplanation: When your app crashes on a customer's phone in Japan, you instantly get an alert in Slack with the exact line of code that caused the crash.

answers.question: Define Error Tracking.
answers.answer: Error Tracking is a key non-functional requirement for robust frontend systems.
